name: house-prompt-card
summary: A rounded prompt field with a tiny mono label ("TO CLAUDE"), text typed at a steady characters-per-second rate with a blinking-free caret (it simply follows the text), and a round send button that turns into "SENT" at the end.

variables.default: Cut every pause over 0.3 s and keep the last clean take of each line.

notes: Full usage in the comment header of the .html file.
